title: The numerators grew by what factor?
text: 15 is 3 times 5, so the denominators must grow by that same factor if the ratios are equal. A common mistake is to cross-multiply and then divide by the wrong term. What factor takes the numerator 5 to the numerator 15?

title: Scale the denominator by that factor
Worked solution
text: $$\frac{5}{8} = \frac{15}{x}$$ gives $$x = 24$$, because $$5 \times 24 = 120$$ and $$8 \times 15 = 120$$. Common mistake: answering $$x = \frac{8}{3}$$ by inverting the scale factor. General rule: if the numerators are in a factor of $$k$$, the denominators are in the same factor. Equivalently, cross-multiply and divide by the coefficient of the variable.
